obs = observe()

# Choose candidate with fingers across the long side (yaw aligned to pen's long axis)
candidate = next(c for c in candidates if abs(c["yaw"] - pen["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1 and c["source"] == "geometry (fingers across the long side)")
grasp(candidate)
spots = free_spots("green_case", "blue_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
# Compute required gripper yaw to align pen with case long axis
delta_yaw = case["long_axis_yaw"] - candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=delta_yaw)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("blue_pen", "green_case")
